The Warrior Assault Rifle is a ranged weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is an Assault Rifle. It must be purchased during the Normal Mission The Bodyguard for 12,500 Credits, along with the Iron Sword and the Titanium Shield in order to arm Zazazan's bodyguard, Harvey.

Voltnets are back weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Colubrims or Oc-servs.
W-Crushers are back weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Cetos, Tornado Claw type Galdrs or black Puges.
Voltstorms are shoulder weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from white Marnucks, M-Laser/Spine-Cannon/E-Bubble/B-Bomb types Qmoevas.

Vulture Peck (Japanese: , Vu~aruchābīku, Lit. "Vulture Beak") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using a Megalance.
Vortex Edge (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using the Dual Scythes.
Venal Igna (Japanese: , Akusen Igūna) are enemies in . They are members of the Igna family, and can be found at level 34-35 in the Chansagh Wastes of the Empire of Mor Ardain. They ride on Rhinons.

The Verdant Plateau (Japanese: , Sansui no Kōgen) is a Location in . It is located in the right area of the upper level of Gormott Province, at the head of Varnax's Plunge. It may be reached by swimming across the pool and jumping to a platform from the rocks at the waterfall, and Cherlie can be found here during One Step Ahead.
The Verde Carpentry Workshop (Japanese: , Vorude Mokuzai Kakōjō) is a Location in . It is located in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Vile Howard (Japanese: , Shishū no Bunga) is a Unique Monster in . He is a member of the Blant family and can be found wandering in poison at level 47 at the Wonder Spring Plaza Ruins in Spirit Crucible Elpys.
Victory Smoothies are Drink Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Café Savvy run by Adwen in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
The Volty Deeds are Store Deeds in . They can be purchased from Volty Butchers in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.
The Vibrattio Deeds are Store Deeds in . They can be purchased from Vibrattio Instruments in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Volty Butchers is a shop in . It is run by Havard in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. It is specialized in Meat.
Vibrattio Instruments is a shop in . It is run by Rhoyna and can be found in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya. It is specialized in Instruments.
Vonny is an NPC in . Vonny is an Urayan who can be found in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. Vonny runs a shop called Brad Flatforms specialized in Staple Foods.
Vinaigrette Ice Cabbages are Veggie Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Lectica Vegetables in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. It is one of the favorite Pouch items of Perceval.
Vess's Dumplings are Staple Foods items in . They can be created by Vess at the Vess's Dumplings kitchen, which is located at the back of Mabon's house near Tretl Windmill Plaza in Torigoth, Gormott.
Voltaic Slash (Japanese: , Surasshuboruto Lit. "Slash Bolt") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using a Big Bang Edge.

Venal Montgomery (Japanese: , Akujiki no Gariru) is a Unique Monster in . He is a member of the Brog family and can be found at level 45 on the northeastern shore of Coolley Lake on the Upper Level - Right area of the Gormott Province.
Volkas Drivers (Japanese: , Borukasu Doraibā) are enemies in . They are Drivers. One can be found at level 13 on Melnath's Shoulder in the Gormott Province, alongside a Denes Driver.

Walker Trap (Japanese: , Hiyori Sanpo no Mādoresu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a Driver and a member of the Blant family, and can be found at level 26 in the northwest of Farlaine Central Pools in the Kingdom of Uraya.
|-|XC2 = |-|TTGC = Vinegar Leaves are Tree collectibles in and . They can be found in the Gormott Province and Gormott. In the , Vinegar Leaves can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.
Wall Ignas (Japanese: , Wōru Igūna) are enemies in . They are Ignas and can be found at level 18-22 around Tardy Gate or Drillbore Bridge in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya.

Vestro is an NPC in . He is an Urayan mercenary who can be found at the Training Ground in Garfont Village, Kingdom of Uraya. He stands against a wall, with his Female Common Blade. If Floren is in the party and has "Lv 5 Beguiling Charms", he will give the party three Cube Chips.

Vint Griffoxes (Japanese: , Vinto Repādo) are enemies in . They are members of the Griffox family, and can be found at level 39-43 on the Twin Pillars in the Kingdom of Tantal. Two must be defeated to unlock Corvin's level 4 Lacerna Noctis on his affinity chart.

Victory Loquats are Vegetable collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya, in particular from the Collection Points located around Gullet Pass, south of the Eight-Rock Skip, northeast of Yurna the Elderwood, left of the Cobalt Cliffs, and also one at the Greatmaw Rapids. In the , Victory Loquats can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo. They can be offered to Pekka as food for her Adult Ardun raising the progression bar by two points.
Vinenuts are Tree collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Tantal.

Vortex Panels are Mechanical collectibles in . They can be found by Salvaging at the 7th Perimeter Skyport in the World Tree, or in the First Low Orbit Station. One is needed to refine Blade Combo Boost VI.

Walking Encyclopedia is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located in the Argentum Bazaar in the Argentum Trade Guild, right next to the Reedirait Bookstore. It can only be viewed once tier 3 of Adenine's Affinity Chart is unlocked. It must be viewed to unlock Adenine's Lv 3 Harness the Wind.

Vogar Aspids (Japanese: , Viggā Asupīdo) are enemies in . They are members of the Aspid family, and can be found at level 87 in the Kingdom of Tantal, at the Sealed Quarry on the Upper Level, or at the Memorial Ruins in the Head. They only appear during misty weather.

Warehouse Work is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya by talking to Hamlish at the Mercenary HQ, after Garfont Mercenaries reaches Merc Level 3. The time required to complete this mission is 50 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 12 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Mental Arithmetic", "Transport Mastery" and "Agronomy" Field Skills.
Velvan Tirkin (Japanese: , Beruben Tākin) are enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 30-32 on Daram Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago.
Wacon Upas (Japanese: , Wākon Ūpā) are enemies in . They are members of the Upa family, and can be found at level 42 - 44 on Godsford Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Walraig (Japanese: , Wataon) is an NPC in . Walraig is a Urayan mercenary who can be found at the Brionac Occupied Zone in the Empire of Mor Ardain. He is the Driver of Akatsuki, who gives orders to Brionac on his behalf. After his fight with the party during Insurgent Investigations, Walraig commands Akatsuki to kill him.
Vess's Core Crystal is a special Core Crystal in . It allows to awake Vess and is obtained as a reward after completing Tranquility.

Waldemar (Japanese: , Ozuwaru) is an NPC in . He is a Urayan who can be found aboard the Valdorm's Mound in the Empire of Mor Ardain, then at the Lost Capital Judicium in Temperantia. He was the Driver of Theory.

The Verdi Crystal is a Key Item in . It is received from Misimisi during Precious Yearnings by having him appraise a Strange Mineral from a prospecting point in Pippito's Haunt in the Kingdom of Tantal.
Volette is an NPC in . Volette is an Urayan who can be found at Fonsa Myma Port in the Kingdom of Uraya. He is Vaio and Veero's father, and is involved during Theory and Praxis.

Vocal Lesson 1 (Japanese: , Bōkaru Ressun 1) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild during the Blade Quest Bearing Her Soul. The time required to complete this mission is 10 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 2 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Focus" and "Dark Mastery" Field Skills. It rewards Vocals Stamps that are necessary to level up Ursula's Vocal Level. It also slightly increases Ursula's fanbase the first time it is cleared.

Vocal Lesson 2 (Japanese: , Bōkaru Ressun 2) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild during the Blade Quest Bearing Her Soul, after Ursula's Vocals reach Level 2. The time required to complete this mission is 10 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 2 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Focus" and "Earth Mastery" Field Skills. It rewards Vocals Stamps that are necessary to level up Ursula's Vocal Level. It also slightly increases Ursula's fanbase the first time it is cleared.

Vocal Lesson 3 (Japanese: , Bōkaru Ressun 3) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild during the Blade Quest Bearing Her Soul, after Ursula's Vocals reach Level 4. The time required to complete this mission is 10 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 2 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Focus" and "Light Mastery" Field Skills. It rewards Vocals Stamps that are necessary to level up Ursula's Vocal Level. It also slightly increases Ursula's fanbase the first time it is cleared.

Vocal Lesson 4 (Japanese: , Bōkaru Ressun 4) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild during the Blade Quest Bearing Her Soul, after Ursula's Vocals reach Level 6. The time required to complete this mission is 10 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 2 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Focus" and "Fire Mastery" Field Skills. It rewards Vocals Stamps that are necessary to level up Ursula's Vocal Level. It also slightly increases Ursula's fanbase the first time it is cleared. This mission will become unobtainable if not unlocked before the end of the quest.

Vocal Lesson 5 (Japanese: , Bōkaru Ressun 5) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild during the Blade Quest Bearing Her Soul, after Ursula's Vocals reach Level 8. The time required to complete this mission is 10 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 2 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Focus", "Water Mastery" and "Earth Mastery" Field Skills. It rewards Vocals Stamps that are necessary to level up Ursula's Vocal Level. It also slightly increases Ursula's fanbase the first time it is cleared. This mission will become unobtainable if not unlocked before the end of the quest.
Vendetta is a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . It increases damage dealt to enemies targeting Tora by up to 50%. It can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__
Vicious Circle is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using Infinity Fans. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0).
Viccus is an NPC in . He is a Tantalese who runs the Anastatia's inn in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.
Viviline is an NPC in . She is an Indoline who can be found at Poldis Circle in the Indoline Praetorium. She runs the shop Jugos Antiques.
Vocals Stamps are Key Items in . They can be obtained as rewards for completing the Merc Missions Vocal Lessons 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 during the quest Bearing Her Soul.
Vend is an NPC in . He is a young Urayan who can be found in the Quality Control Tower of the Old Factory in the Empire of Mor Ardain where he must be rescued during the Quest Eternal Spirit.

Vindictive Levalion (Japanese: , Setsujoku no Reberio) is a quest-exclusive enemy in . He is an Indoline guard, and can be found at level 63 at the Hot Pipe District, 1F in the Empire of Mor Ardain during the Blade Quest Lingering Resentment, along with the Indoline Falchion and Avengers. This enemy drops no items.
|-|XC2 = |-|TTGC = Volff Fangs are Enemy Part collectibles in and . They can be dropped by Rip Volffs and one is required during the DLC Quest A Smith's Pastime.

The Vyktym Igna (Japanese: , Vikutimu Igūna) is a quest-exclusive boss in . It is a member of the Igna family, and can be found at level 61 on the Desta Plains in Temperantia during A Mercenary's Honor, alongside the Sakryfyce Igna and Blood-Crazed Stalker.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = War God Banners (Japanese: , Gunshin no Danki) are DLC accessories in . They increase damage dealt against launched enemies by up to 135%. They are the upgraded version of the Swordfighting Banner, Goddess Banner and Ancient Banner accessories. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Violent Stones (Japanese: , Burūtaru Sutōn) are DLC accessories in . They increase the damage dealt by Auto-Attacks by up to 90%. They are the upgraded version of the Attack Stone, Assault Stone and Break Stone accessories. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass.

The Volffmaster (Japanese: , Vorufumasutā) is a Challenge Battle Enemy in . It is a member of the Gogol family fought at level 110 during the third wave of the Challenge Battle Reinventing the Gogol. This enemy drops no items.

Wall Sovereigns (Japanese: , Wōru Roiyaru) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are Kustal-type Sovereigns that are fought at level 102 during the Challenge Battle Mk. VIII. Two can be summoned by the Decacent Sovereign, but none naturally spawn at the start of the wave.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Vivid Mitts (Japanese: , Bibitto Gurabu) are DLC accessories in . They increase the wearer's Dexterity stat by up to 37%. They are the upgraded version of the Rainbow Gloves, Hero Gloves and Carbon Gloves accessories. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. For a similar additive effect that can stack with this gear, check the Leather Gloves and Smithy Gloves accessories.
Victory Slash (Japanese: , Uiningusurasshu, Lit. "Winning Slash") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when wielding an Uchigatana. This art recycles Rex's Dual Slash.

Vill Ethelmar is an NPC in . He is the Ardainian Special Inquisitor during the Aegis War. He can be found at Aletta: Militia Garrison in the Kingdom of Torna, and in the Strategy Room on Lascham Cove, and finally at Aureus Palace. He gives no quests, but his Community is gained upon speaking to him once Community level 5 is reached.

The Verdant Fairylands (Japanese: , Mebuki no Senkyōchi) is a location in . It is located on a large mesa in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna, and accessing it requires Aegaeon's Geyser Launch to be used from Lake Wynn. There is a Treasure Trove, a Large Old Machine, several Collection Points and a Green Barrel containing Red Pollen Orbs here. The Key Item Pestronella must be collected here during Further Feeding Issues. The Cherry Slate Piece can be found here.

Vi Sezha's Bracelet is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be found during the course of Until the End, and must be collected in order to complete one route. It is located in Cauldros's Boxtrap Checkpoint on the cliff opposite Ge Jewhe, right next to a Lv 2 Archaeology Field Action.

Wandering Urchons (Japanese: , Toraberu Unin) are Quest-exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Urchon family and can be found at level 37 in the Aletta Region of the Kingdom of Torna, at Aletta Harbor. Three of them must be defeated during The Travails of War. As with all Quest-exclusive Enemies in , Wandering Urchons drop no items, only gold.

Wandering Ropl (Japanese: , Toraberu Ryibura) are Quest-exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Ropl family and can be found at level 39 in the Aletta Region of the Kingdom of Torna, in Aletta: Militia Garrison. Two of them must be defeated during The Travails of War. As with all Quest-exclusive Enemies in , Wandering Ropl drop no items, only gold.

Wandering Laias (Japanese: , Toraberu Raia) are Quest-exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Laia family and can be found at level 41 in the Aletta Region of the Kingdom of Torna, at Aletta: Militia Garrison. Two of them must be defeated during The Travails of War. As with all Quest-exclusive Enemies in , Wandering Laias drop no items, only gold.

Vibrant Flamii Wings are Enemy Part collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna.

Vokkon Griffoxes (Japanese: , Vōkusu Repādo) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Griffox family and can be found at level 30 - 38 in the Dannagh Desert and the Golden Twin Mesa in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna.

Ventts Ropl (Japanese: , Wentosu Ryibura) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Ropl family and can be found at level 36 - 40 at Streamsand Corridor in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna. Two must be defeated to unlock Brighid's level 5 Wheel of Penance Blade Special.

The Victor Totem is a minor enemy in . It is a Totem that can be found at level 20 - 23 at the entrance to the Tirkin Cliff Colony in the Aletta Region of the Kingdom of Torna. It is one of only two Totems in the game, the other being the Glorr Totem.

Vient Horrison is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian ambassador who can be found in the Ardainian ship's Strategy Room on Gormott. He gives the quest Sweetest Tidings, upon completion of which his Community is gained, alongside Hal Jarque. He develops a fondness for Melosian Honey.

Vronka is an NPC in . She is an Urayan soldier who can be found at Aletta Harbor in the Kingdom of Torna. She gives the quest Making Up the Numbers and is involved during Community Spirit where she is found at Aletta: Militia Garrison. Her Community is gained upon completion of the former, alongside that of Luc and the Four Muskerpon.

Vez is an NPC in . He is a Tornan soldier who can be found upstairs in the Aletta: Militia Garrison in the Kingdom of Torna, and works directly for Addam, although can be clumsy and distracted due to trying to help his sick grandmother on top of his retainer duties. He gives the quest What Matters Most, and his Community is gained upon its completion.

Vicejaw Antols (Japanese: , Kyōgaku no Antoru) are Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They appear during No Armu Done and must be defeated to complete the quest. They are members of the Antol family, and three can be found at level 67 west of Thulles Way on the Bionis' Shoulder. As with all Quest Exclusive Enemies in , the Vicejaw Antols drop no chests.

Wallflower (Japanese: , Hitomishiri) is a quest in . It can be received from Angela near the Gran Dell Approach on the Bionis' Shoulder whilst Kino is party leader. Upon completion of this quest, Brace for Friendship is unlocked.
Voqzen is a Machina NPC in . He can be found in Gran Dell on the Bionis' Shoulder.

Vredda is a Machina NPC in . She can be found in Gran Dell near the Grand Arch on the Bionis' Shoulder. After the Teelan's Laboratory attack event and completion of the quest New Way of Life, she gives the quest Hook, Line and Sinker, where she asks for help with developing a new fishing device she's working on with Bartholomew.
The Warped Bangle is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. It is found on the high ground at Shoulderstone Scree, and is required for Brother's Keepsake given by Lavean.
Wake-Up Whirl is Finch's Level III Blade Special in . Wake-Up Whirl is also Finch's Special Art during Merc Assault missions in the .

The Vista of Rhonnar (Japanese: , Ron'a no Tenbō) is a landmark in . It is located in High Maktha Wildwood in the Pentelas Region. It is accessed from the Old Cliffside Way.

The Wall of the Great Hand (Japanese: , Shōchū no Chōjō) is a Landmark in , located in the Eagus Wilderness. It is the remains of the palm of the Mechonis' Fallen Arm, and the former site of the Hidden Machina Village. It is also known as the "Mechonis Hand". The Metamural Garden is located behind it, which can be reached by going through the passageway that once served as the entrance into the Hidden Machina Village.
The Warning Tree (Japanese: , Keikoku no Hyōju) is a Landmark in . It is located in the Low Maktha Wildwood in the Pentelas Region.

War and Peace is a track from , composed by Manami Kiyota. It is track five of disc three from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track five of disc eight from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays in the menus for the Merc Group.

Walking with You is a track from , composed by ACE. It is track six of disc five from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track six of disc ten from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. It is an orchestral version of Desolation. This song plays during the following moments: * Vandham sacrifices himself to allow the party to escape from Malos and Akhos. * Rex mourning Fan la Norne's death in Temperantia. * The party confronting Jin and Malos at the Gotrock Oracle Ruins. * Jin's story of how he consumed Lora's heart to become a Flesh Eater. * Mikhail encourages the party to chase Jin and Malos, and then blows up the Marsanes to sink Indol. * Jin's sacrifice in order to kill Amal

Wanted Nia is a track in , composed by ACE. It is track twenty of disc one on the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track twenty of disc six from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. It plays during comical moments in various cutscenes from the main story and from Blade Quests.

Velmo is an NPC in . He is an Urayan who can be found in Fonsa Myma's Commercial District in the Kingdom of Uraya during A Helping Hand, where he runs one of the distribution centers for the Indoline refugee relief effort.

Weather Fliers (Japanese: , Wezā Furaia) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Flier family. They can be found on Kneecap Hill in Tephra Cave at approximately level 10. They only appear in the daytime during clear weather. They can drop the Flier Straws needed for A Gutsy Trader.

White Plums (Japanese: , Howaito Puramu) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found on the Fallen Arm. According to their description, they are tangy fruit with a white pulp and they are mouth-watering sight. Three are required for the reconstruction of Colony 6. In Definitive Edition, they can be purchased in Time Attack place from Nopon Archsage for 11,800 Noponstones.

Water Upas (Japanese: , Wōtā Ūpā) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Upa family, and can be found at level 17 on the Splintered Path in Colony 6 and around the Drainage Outlet leading to the Ether Mine during rain. Defeating three of them is required to complete the quest Safety First given by Daza in Colony 6.

Winding Gears (Japanese: , Windingu Gia) are collectables in . They can be found on Bionis' Leg and later in Colony 6. According to their description, they are curved white cogs, the reason behind it being unknown.

Water Boatmans (Japanese: , Mushisuberi) are collectables in . They can be found in Mechonis Field and Colony 6. According to their description, they are hard to pick up because of their slipperiness which protects them against foes.
White Night Rods (Japanese: , Byakuya Burīchi) are collectables in . They can be found in Colony 6. According to their description, Reyn was quick to name them and they are white shiny metal rods.

Wicked Sallos (Japanese: , Enma no Sareosu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Pterix family, and can be found at level 95 on the Distant Fingertip on the Fallen Arm. It does not appear in rainy or thunderstorm conditions. It can drop a Pterix Energy Egg, two of which are needed for one path of Lifespan of a Machina.

White Tubes (Japanese: , Howaito Chūbu) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found in the High Entia Tomb. According to their description, they are pieces of broken vacuum tubes but their beauty endures.

White Beetles (Japanese: , Shirosujiosamushi) are collectables in . They can be found in Colony 9. According to their description, they are beetles with white stripes that beat their smooth wings to call.

White Ladybirds (Japanese: , Shirogomatentou) are collectables in . They can be found on Bionis' Leg and later in Colony 6. According to their description, they are ladybirds with white spots all over them and males are known by another name.

White Songbirds (Japanese: , Junpaku no Kazanakidori) are collectables in . They can be found on Bionis' Leg. According to their description, Shulk gave them a poetic name and they make a fresh sound in the breeze.

Water Logs (Japanese: , Wōtā Bōdo, Water Board) are collectables in . They can be found in Satorl Marsh. According to their description, they are black logs that are constantly damp as if they were soaked in water.

White Tails (Japanese: , Howaito Tēru) are collectables in . They can be found in the Eryth Sea and Colony 6. According to their description, they are saplings like a white fox's tail and they are used as bedding for small animals. Two are required for the Timed Quest Collection Quest 2 at Alcamoth.

Wheel Lurkers (Japanese: , Sharingakure) are collectables in . They can be found in Galahad Fortress and Colony 6 or traded for with Mixik on the Fallen Arm. According to their description, they dwell in the cogs of machinery and their secretions clog the wheels.

White Styrenes (Japanese: , Shiro Suchirōru ) are collectables in . They can be found in the Central Factory and Colony 6. According to their description, they are half-mechanised boards transplanted with soft downy fur.

Warrior Screws (Japanese: , Bushi Dōneji) are collectables in . They can be found in the Central Factory and Colony 6. According to their description, they are red with rust and they are gutsy wild little screws.

Warrior Plates are heavy torso armour in . They can be bought in Colony 6 or traded for with Désirée.

The Watchpoint Junction (Japanese: , Monomi no Sansaro) is a landmark in . It is located at the north end of Colony 6, a little way south of the Supply Road, the entrance to this area from Bionis' Leg. Nearby this landmark is a lift which leads down to Splintered Path and the entrance to the Ether Mine.

Warrior Cuisses are heavy legs armour in . They were developed during the last war between Bionis and Mechonis for the troops on the front lines. They are not dropped by any enemies, but can be bought or traded for. In the , this armour has a different colour scheme than in the original game (Titan Type I).

Windy Cave (Japanese: , Kazanari no Kūdō) is a location in . It is located on the lower level of Bionis' Leg. It is a large cave northeast of Raguel Bridge - North. Inside the cave are some extremely strong monsters, such as a large number of level 74 Royal Caterpiles. In the middle of the cave is the rock pillar with the spiraling path up it which leads to Spiral Valley. This path is blocked halfway up unless Making a New Path is completed. This path allows the party to revisit the top platform of Spiral Valley without defeating the Immovable Gonzalez. Warrior Helms (Japanese: , Wōria Herumu) are heavy head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are only available from a single shop.
